style: Premium closing brand sting for a Turkish customs-exam school. Deep navy night with a warm orange ember glow, drifting light motes. Logo assembles part-by-part on the presenter's spoken brand name, then a warm wish line. Confident, celebratory, never cartoonish.

catalog_searched: logo sting reveal brand lockup with glow and tagline -> logo-outro, logo-sting, logo-brand-close (16:9 generic piece-slide / slam; cannot carry per-part voice-synced beats)
diagonal light sweep shine across a logo -> shimmer-sweep, gloss-sweep, light-sweep-pass (rectangular overlays; adapted as an SVG alpha-masked gradient band so the sheen stays on the logo shapes)
floating light particles bokeh background -> no fitting item (search miss)
soft radial glow behind logo -> logo-outro glow idiom reused as an ambient-glow-bloom layer
rules: hyperframes-animation/rules/spring-pop-entrance (badges, playful variant with OVERSHOOT 1.6 per brief)
hyperframes-animation/rules/ambient-glow-bloom (hero bloom + bounded breathe; diagonal raked sweep variation)
hyperframes-animation/rules/svg-icon-enrichment (tassel swing via SVG transform attribute around the cord pivot)
motion-vocabulary: word_reveal/wave (letter rise), fade_blur (line 1), letter-spacing track-in (line 2), underline_sweep (flanking rules), hold_breath (logo 1.00->1.03), fade_out

content.wordmark_visual_order_note: SVG path order inside #wordmark is C, N, ’, L, I, A (A is the last path); the stagger uses visual left-to-right order C, A, N, ’, L, I.

timeline.what: glow breathes up from 0.20 to 0.36 opacity; particles already drifting
#wordmark letters rise from baseline clip, expo.out, 0.06 s stagger (C A N ’ L I)
#cap falls (power2.in) onto A at 1.58, rebounds 28 units, settles 1.80; A micro-squash; tassel decaying swing 1.58->3.2
#tagline soft-edge mask wipe left->right (sine.inOut), edge reaches 'Merkezi' ~1.77
line 1 rise + blur-to-sharp, second row +0.12 s
line 2 letter-spacing track-in + flanking hairlines grow outward
one diagonal sheen band across the logo shapes (alpha-masked to the logo)
hold: logo wrapper scale 1.00->1.03, particles drift, glow breathes
full-frame fade to black (power1.in); last frame fully black
